build_sparse_resnet: build a SparseResNet model with specified depth and sparse batch normalization for sparse feature extraction
convert_dense_to_sparse: convert a dense PyTorch ResNet model to sparse modules using the dense_model_to_sparse method
create_sparse_conv_layers: create sparse convolution layers by converting standard Conv2d modules to SparseConv2d with copied weights
build_sparse_batch_norm: build sparse batch normalization layers by converting BatchNorm2d to SparseBatchNorm2d or SparseSyncBatchNorm2d
convert_pooling_to_sparse: convert MaxPool2d and AvgPool2d layers to SparseMaxPooling and SparseAvgPooling sparse equivalents
